name: histcounts_norm
expr: cnt = histcounts(x, e); pr = histcounts(x, e, 'Normalization', 'probability'); cd = histcounts(xu, eu, 'Normalization', 'countdensity'); pf = histcounts(xu, eu, 'Normalization', 'pdf'); cc = histcounts(x, e, 'Normalization', 'cumcount'); cf = histcounts(x, e, 'Normalization', 'cdf');
comment: Sig: n = histcounts(x, edges, 'Normalization', mode). Covers count(def)/probability(/N)/countdensity(/binwidth)/pdf(/(N*binwidth))/cumcount/cdf, with uniform and nonuniform edges, and out-of-range data so the divisor N = numel(x) (not the in-range count) — e.g. cdf(end)=7/9 not 1. Queue-clearing 2026-05-29: numkit previously silently ignored 'Normalization' (always raw counts).
